summary: xAI released 21 new multilingual voices for Grok Voice, alongside improved naturalness for its original five voices and new speech-tag controls, available via its Voice Agent API, TTS API, and new Voice Agent Builder.

practices.reason: The original five voices were retrained for more natural speech output, but the change is described qualitatively with no benchmark or quantified gain.
practices.quote: They've been retrained with an improved recipe, so pacing, phrasing, and emphasis are more natural.

practices.reason: Speech markup tags give developers a concrete, documented way to control delivery (pauses, emphasis, whisper) within voice agent pipelines.
practices.quote: Speech tags like [pause] and <whisper> can be used to control the delivery.
